usedFor: Ybug collects website feedback, where “Update Feedback” sets status and priority and “Add Comment to Feedback” replies.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in Moco, then “Create Project” in Ybug
bestTemplate.why: A new project elsewhere gets a feedback project in Ybug, ready to gather annotated screenshots.

watchOut: “Delete Project” permanently deletes a project with its annotated screenshots and comments, so check it first.
